title: Trump and Xi Jinping meet in bilateral summit with gestures of friendship and disagreements over Taiwan
summary: The leaders of the U.S. and China hold a state dinner and talks highlighting cooperation on AI but tensions persist over Taiwan and trade.

title: Long-term interest rates in Japan reach 3.115%, level not seen in 30 years
summary: The yield on 10-year Japanese bonds rises to 3.115% driven by the rise in U.S. rates, marking highs since 1994.

title: Credit card companies to cover 53 billion yen after Zen-To-Shin bankruptcy
summary: Seven major card issuers agreed to reimburse all unrecovered funds to about 20,000 merchants affected by the collapse of the mutual aid association.

title: Hanshin Tigers pitcher Yuki Nishi announces retirement after 127 career wins
summary: The 34-year-old right-hander, first Heisei-era born player to throw a no-hitter, hangs up his glove at season's end with no regrets.

title: Japan's Emperor and Empress visit Kumamoto to comfort those affected by 2016 earthquake
summary: Their Majesties make a one-day visit to Kumamoto Prefecture, where aftereffects of the magnitude-7 quake eight years ago still linger.

title: Netanyahu delivers speech at UN amid protests and delegate walkouts over ICC arrest warrant
summary: The Israeli prime minister speaks at the General Assembly as protesters demand his arrest and several delegations leave the chamber in rejection.

title: Starbucks to close 250 stores in North America to simplify menus and regain profitability
summary: The chain cites menu complexity and price hikes as causes of customer exodus and accelerates its restructuring plan.

title: Typhoon Dujuan (No. 25) leaves at least 11 dead in eastern Japan and heads toward being designated a severe disaster
summary: The government plans to designate the storm as a major disaster as rescue and damage assessment operations continue.

title: British and Japanese funds propose buying Kobayashi Pharmaceutical to take it private
summary: The pharmaceutical company, under pressure over contaminated supplements, receives a joint acquisition offer that sent its stock to the daily limit.

title: Agriculture Ministry orders Fukui to correct sale of 'snow crab' that was mostly 'water crab'
summary: More than half of the shells offered as tax-donation returns in Echizen City contained the lower-value species, violating labeling law.

title: Shizuoka and Yamanashi to coordinate helicopter rescue fees on Mount Fuji
summary: Both prefectures seek a common fee system to deter reckless climbs and fund costly emergency operations.

title: Deceased former neighbor charged in double murder of mother and daughter in Hyogo a decade ago
summary: Police sent case papers to prosecutors after finding DNA of the suspect, who committed suicide in 2014, at the crime scene in Tatsuno.

title: Nikkei rises over 700 points, tops 36,000 yen driven by tech stocks
summary: Japan's benchmark index rebounds strongly after recent declines, led by Tokyo Electron and other semiconductors.

title: One month after Nepal avalanche, victims still homeless and hydropower investments questioned
summary: The disaster, exacerbated by glacial melt, has reignited debate over the safety of hydroelectric projects in the Himalayas.

title: Japanese swimmer Shin Ohashi breaks world record in 200m breaststroke at Asian Games
summary: Ohashi, 20, swam 2:07.01 in the final, beating the previous mark by nearly a second and surprising even his rivals.
